sn22.32:1.2: pabhaṅguñca vo kho bhikkhave, desissāmi appabhaṅguñca.
sn22.32:1.6: yo tassa nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, idaṃ appabhaṅgu.
sn22.32:1.8: yo tassā nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, idaṃ appabhaṅgu.
sn22.32:1.9: saññā pabhaṅgu yo tassā nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, idaṃ appabhaṅgu,
sn22.32:1.11: yo tesaṃ nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, idaṃ appabhaṅgu.
sn22.32:1.13: yo tassa nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, idaṃ appabhaṅgūti.
